science.title: Caffeine that doesn't crash you
science.text: Most energy drinks spike you, then drop you. We pair 200 mg of natural green-tea caffeine with 100 mg of L-theanine — the amino acid that smooths caffeine into calm, focused energy — plus citrate electrolytes and a full B-vitamin complex so your body actually turns it into usable fuel.

items.q: How much caffeine is in it?
items.a: 200 mg of natural green-tea caffeine per 2-scoop serving — about two cups of coffee. Start with one scoop if you're sensitive to caffeine.
Morning or pre-workout works best. Avoid taking it within ~8 hours of bed so the caffeine doesn't affect your sleep.
The 100 mg of L-theanine is there to smooth the caffeine into calm, focused energy — most people find it far gentler than coffee or energy drinks.
Pregnant or nursing women, children under 18, and anyone sensitive to caffeine or with a medical condition should consult a physician before use. Do not exceed the recommended serving.
